en.title: Reuse clipping work in shared 2D rendering
en.body: Sibling draws can share the resolved clip stack. Strictly convex clipped triangles and quads use a bounded fast path. WebGPU sets the full viewport and scissor once per geometry pass.

zh.title: 共享 2D 渲染复用裁剪计算
zh.body: 相邻绘制可复用已解析的裁剪栈。裁剪后的严格凸三角形和四边形可在原预算内快速完成准备。WebGPU 在每次几何渲染通道中设置一次全幅视口和裁剪区域。
